name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_pancreatitis_now@@mild
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis is of mild severity.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis and the severity is mild.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis and the severity is not mild.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the severity of the patient's acute pancreatitis is mild.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_pancreatitis_now@@severe

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of acute pancreatitis and the severity is not severe.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the severity of the patient's acute pancreatitis is severe.

when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a diagnosis of malignant neoplastic disease (cancer) in the late timeframe.

name: patient_is_near_death_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently near death (death is imminent or expected soon).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently near death, meaning death is imminent or expected soon.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not near death, meaning death is not imminent or expected soon.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently near death.
